early_roster_note: Some classes don't open for sign-up until closer to the date. Want a spot now? Text me and I'll put you on the roster early.

offerings.title: Private lessons
offerings.detail: 1-on-1 coaching at Chipshot or Pictona, built around your game.
offerings.cta: Text to book a private lesson
offerings.sms_body: Hi Katy! I'd like to book a private lesson.

offerings.title: Group lessons & play dates
offerings.detail: Bring a friend or two and split the coaching.
offerings.note: Larger groups can be booked too. Text me for pricing.
offerings.cta: Text to book a group lesson
offerings.sms_body: Hi Katy! I'd like to book a group lesson.

offerings.title: Quad Squad
offerings.detail: Your group of 4: play a game, fix the pain points, then play again with live feedback. Go 90 minutes to get the most out of it.
offerings.cta: Text to book a Quad Squad
offerings.sms_body: Hi Katy! I'd like to book a Quad Squad for my group of 4.

offerings.title: Duos 'n Pros
offerings.detail: Book Katy & Lisa for your own session. Bring your partner, play the Pros, and take home video analysis and shot-by-shot stats.
offerings.sms_body: Hi Katy! My partner and I would like to book a Duos 'n Pros session.
